This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Build a complete invoicing system for a Node.js/JavaScript application with the following key requirements:
   - Support creating draft invoices with customers and line items from a catalogue
   - Calculate invoice totals with support for line discounts, customer tier-based automatic discounts, and VAT
   - Issue invoices with automatic sequential numbering (INV-YYYY-NNNN format, resetting annually)
   - Render invoices as plain text with all amounts formatted in euros
   - Record payments and track invoice status through draft -> issued -> partially_paid -> paid lifecycle
   
   House rules that apply throughout:
   - Money is always stored as integer cents; use roundCents() for any fractional results
   - Never throw exceptions for bad input; always use fail(CODE) pattern with error codes
   - Never mutate arguments; return new objects/arrays
   - Run npm test before declaring any request complete

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Result monad pattern: all functions return { ok: true, value: ... } or { ok: false, error: "CODE" }
   - Error codes as enumerated strings stored in src/errors.js ERRORS object
   - Integer cent arithmetic throughout (no floating-point money)
   - UTC-only date handling to avoid timezone bugs
   - Tiered discount system (gold 5%, silver 2.5%, standard 0%) applied automatically at line level
   - Invoice status progression: draft -> issued -> partially_paid -> paid
   - Customer ID normalization (trim + uppercase)
   - Per-line VAT calculation on post-discount amounts, then summed

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - src/result.js (existing, used throughout):
      - Defines ok(value) and fail(error, details) functions
      - All business logic returns these structures

   - src/errors.js:
      - ERRORS object containing all error codes with descriptions
      - Currently includes: AMOUNT_INVALID, CUSTOMER_INVALID, CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND, UNKNOWN_SKU, DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID, LINE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_DRAFT, COUNTER_OVERFLOW, DISCOUNT_INVALID, NOT_ISSUED, OVERPAYMENT
      - New codes NOT_ISSUED and OVERPAYMENT added for payments

   - src/customers.js:
      - getCustomer(id): looks up customer, now normalizes ID with normalizeId()
      - normalizeId(id): trims whitespace and converts to uppercase
      - TIER_DISCOUNTS object: { gold: 5, silver: 2.5, standard: 0 }
      - validateCustomer(c): validates customer object structure

   - src/catalogue.js (existing):
      - getProduct(sku): returns product with sku, name, unitPrice (cents), vatRate

   - src/invoices.js:
      - createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines }):
        Returns ok(invoice) with { customerId (normalized), issueDate, status: 'draft', lines }
        Each line enriched with { sku, name, qty, unitPrice, vatRate, discountPercent }
        Validates: customer exists, date is YYYY-MM-DD and real, lines not empty, qty positive integer, discount 0-100, SKU exists
        Applies tier discount if line.discountPercent undefined
        Errors: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND, DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID, DISCOUNT_INVALID, UNKNOWN_SKU

      - lineTotal(line): returns qty * unitPrice

      - lineDiscount(line): returns 0 if no discount, else (qty * unitPrice) * discountPercent / 100 rounded with roundCents()

      - lineVAT(line): returns (lineTotal - lineDiscount) * vatRate / 100, rounded with roundCents()

      - invoiceTotals(invoice): returns { subtotal, discount, vat, total } where:
        subtotal = sum of all lineTotal values
        discount = sum of all lineDiscount values
        vat = sum of all lineVAT values
        total = subtotal - discount + vat (clamped at 0)

      - addLine(invoice, { sku, qty, discountPercent }):
        Adds or updates line on draft invoice
        Validates qty, discountPercent, SKU existence
        Applies tier discount if discountPercent undefined
        Returns NOT_DRAFT if status !== 'draft'

      - removeLine(invoice, sku):
        Removes line from draft invoice
        Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice
        Returns NO_LINES if would remove last line
        Returns NOT_DRAFT if status !== 'draft'

      - issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers):
        Changes status to 'issued', assigns number via nextInvoiceNumber()
        Returns NOT_DRAFT if status !== 'draft'
        Preserves all invoice fields

   - src/numbering.js:
      - nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate):
        Format: INV-YYYY-NNNN where NNNN is 0001-9999, resets each year
        Only counts numbers from same year as issueDate
        Returns COUNTER_OVERFLOW if year already has 9999 invoices
        Returns DATE_INVALID if issueDate not YYYY-MM-DD format

   - src/money.js (existing, enhanced):
      - roundCents(x): banker's rounding to nearest whole cent
      - formatEuros(cents): formats as €1,234.56 with thousands separators and 2 decimals
      - parseEuros(text): parses human input like "12.50" or "1,234.56" to cents

   - src/dates.js (NEW):
      - isValidDate(text): returns boolean, validates YYYY-MM-DD format and date existence
      - addDays(date, n): adds n days in UTC, returns YYYY-MM-DD string, throws if invalid input
      - daysBetween(a, b): returns whole days from a to b (b minus a) in UTC, can be negative, throws if invalid input
      - All arithmetic done in UTC via Date.UTC() to avoid timezone issues

   - src/render.js:
      - renderInvoiceText(invoice):
        Returns plain-text string formatted as:
        [Invoice number or DRAFT]
        [Customer name]
        [Line items as: qty× name @ €unitPrice = €lineTotal]
        [Subtotal: €amount] (if > 0)
        [Discount: €amount] (if > 0)
        [VAT: €amount] (if > 0)
        [Total: €amount]
        All amounts use formatEuros()

   - src/payments.js (NEW):
      - recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date }):
        Adds payment to invoice.payments array (creates if missing)
        Validates: status is 'issued' or 'partially_paid', amount is positive integer, date is YYYY-MM-DD
        Checks for overpayment (amount > balance owed)
        Returns ok(newInvoice) with updated payments array and status
        Status: 'paid' when balance = 0, 'partially_paid' otherwise
        Errors: NOT_ISSUED, AMOUNT_INVALID, DATE_INVALID, OVERPAYMENT

      - balanceDue(invoice):
        Returns total - sum of payments, clamped at 0
        Returns 0 for draft invoices

4. Errors and fixes:
   - VAT calculation discrepancy: Initial test expected wrong totals because VAT calculation is per-line on post-discount amounts, not on subtotal. Fixed by recalculating VAT for each test case based on actual (lineTotal - lineDiscount) * vatRate / 100.
   
   - Leap year test failure: Expected daysBetween('2024-01-01', '2024-12-31') to be 364 but should be 365. Fixed test expectation.
   
   - addDays() not throwing on invalid dates: Function was only checking regex match format, not date validity. Fixed by adding isValidDate() call before processing.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Solved UTC timezone issue by using Date.UTC() and getUTC*() methods, never using local timezone methods
   - Solved mutation issue by consistently copying arrays/objects before modifying
   - Solved fractional cent issue by using roundCents() for all calculations

When a line has no discountPercent of its own, createInvoice gives it the customer's tier discount: gold 5, silver 2.5, standard 0. A line's own discountPercent (even 0) always wins. Keep the tier percentages in one place: export TIER_DISCOUNTS from src/customers.js. Add tests."
   - "Invoice numbers. Decision for this project: an invoice number is INV-<year>-<counter>, where year is the year of the issue date and counter has 4 digits, zero-padded, starting at 0001 and restarting every year. Add nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate) in a new src/numbering.js... and issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers) in src/invoices.js, which returns ok(newInvoice) with number set and status 'issued'. Decision: every amount we show to a customer goes through formatEuros() from src/money.js, here and in anything we render later. Add tests."
   - "VAT. Every line has a vatRate in percent (21, 9 or 0). Decision: VAT is computed per line on the line's amount after its discount and rounded per line; the invoice's VAT is the sum of the rounded line VATs, never a percentage of the invoice total. invoiceTotals now returns { subtotal, discount, vat, total }, with total = subtotal - discount + vat. Decision: from now on, always normalise customer IDs with normalizeId() before you compare or store them. Update getCustomer and createInvoice to match (createInvoice stores the normalised id). Add src/dates.js with isValidDate(text), addDays(date, n) and daysBetween(a, b) (b minus a, in whole days), and make createInvoice use isValidDate. Add tests."

Also add balanceDue(invoice): the total minus the payments. Add tests."

8. Current Work:
   Just completed creating src/payments.js with two functions:
   - recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date }): Records a payment on an issued or partially_paid invoice, updating status to 'paid' or 'partially_paid', validating amount as positive integer, date as YYYY-MM-DD, and checking for overpayment
   - balanceDue(invoice): Returns the amount still owed (total - sum of payments), clamped at 0

   import { ok, fail } from './result.js';
   import { invoiceTotals } from './invoices.js';
   import { isValidDate } from './dates.js';
   
   export function recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date }) {
     if (invoice.status !== 'issued' && invoice.status !== 'partially_paid') {
       return fail('NOT_ISSUED');
     }
     if (!Number.isInteger(amount) || amount <= 0) {
       return fail('AMOUNT_INVALID');
     }
     if (!isValidDate(date)) {
       return fail('DATE_INVALID');
     }
     const totals = invoiceTotals(invoice);
     const currentPayments = (invoice.payments || []).reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amount, 0);
     const balanceOwed = totals.total - currentPayments;
     if (amount > balanceOwed) {
       return fail('OVERPAYMENT');
     }
     const newPayments = [...(invoice.payments || []), { amount, date }];
     const newBalance = balanceOwed - amount;
     const status = newBalance === 0 ? 'paid' : 'partially_paid';
     return ok({
       customerId: invoice.customerId,
       issueDate: invoice.issueDate,
       status,
       number: invoice.number,
       lines: invoice.lines,
       payments: newPayments,
     });
   }
   
   export function balanceDue(invoice) {
     if (invoice.status === 'draft') {
       return 0;
     }
     const totals = invoiceTotals(invoice);
     const payments = (invoice.payments || []).reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amount, 0);
     return Math.max(0, totals.total - payments);
   }
